MAUDE reports are sent in by manufacturers, health professionals and patients. A report does not prove that the device caused the event, and report counts are not failure rates.
Reports without a UDI are not linked to a device, so the real number can be higher.
**Sources:** FDA MAUDE and GUDID, FDA MAUDE reports, MAUDE problem codes, FDA recalls and enforcement (BigQuery, data as of 2026-11-08).
